issue.title: Off-by-one error in string.replace length_error condition

discussion.p: #8 and #12 both specify that `size() - xlen >= max_size() - n2` throws `length_error`. For example, a no-op `replace` operation on a string whose `size()` is already `max_size()` is specified to throw. Neither libstdc++ nor libc++ throws for such a case, and the requirement is suspect.
